No exact numeric radius or coordinates are stated. Preserve relative arrangement and endpoint meaning rather than imposing scan-pixel precision or identifying original panel glyphs as Latin Unicode.

review_expectations_sealed_before_candid: Every source circle, labelled point, p line, horizontal length, panel order and comparison must remain visibly correct.
Six visible, finite, on-canvas bracket representations must identify the correct h/r endpoints. Count-only, label-only and native PASS-only checks cannot approve them.
A segmented modern bracket representation is acceptable only if its endpoint projections, extent, separation, and visible attachment preserve all six source interval meanings.
Executable assertions must cover circle membership, perpendicular feet, collinearity/betweenness, actual lengths and case intersections, not merely object counts.
English/Latin math labels and modern ordered (a)/(b)/(c) names are appropriate; source typography, original panel-glyph identity and cultural scan texture are not required.
Reuse unchanged native/dimension/browser evidence, inspect the retained FIG187-only contact once, and do not replay renderer/browser.
